author: Fredddyy
quote:
If it weren’t a GTA game I would’ve never bought it. Here are my reason justifying my review.

- Terrible Story
- Lucia is insufferable (Should’ve made it Mandy instead)
- Lucia is a self insert character and it’s obvious
- Racism (against Whites and literally no other race)
- Jason is a bland character with near no personality
- The only unkillable non story NPC is a non binary character (obvious prop)
- Story flip flops too much
- Unexperienced writers (it seriously shows)
- Lucia can cheat on Jason but not vice versa
- Writers seem to make Jason gay at certain parts??
- bugs many many bugs (least cared about no game is perfect when it comes to bugs)
- There is moments where the game shows you something interesting or teases you into doing something crazy/fun but then limits you
- Story seems to hold your hand
- Planes and boats have no crash physics
- Far too restrictive for a GTA game
- Content that is locked due to future updates even if you have the deluxe edition
- FPS dips
- Much more but I am blanking as of now

The good:
- Role Play mechanics
- Car crash physics
- UI
- Gas System
- I like how cash is similar to real world money unlike previous GTA game
- Graphics

That’s really about it.

My review:

GTA 6 is nothing like it’s previous successful titles, ultimately losing its charm to horrendous writing, characters and woke propaganda. 13 years of development should be long enough to come up with a linear story of some sort but instead we are left with a tangled, uninteresting and often times confusing plot. The new dev team at rockstar seems to show their lack of experience while attempting to create a game for the non existent “modern audience”. Overall for a GTA game as far as the story goes it is a definite 0/10. This is score I will give it as it is a story game that has had 13 years of development. Now as far as gameplay it’s close to being the best. But we don’t buy GTA solely for the gameplay. We buy it for the story and to do crazy things we otherwise couldn’t in real life. But all in all this has been a complete disappointment.
